data.name: Ricarda
data.gender_notes: Ricarda is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Germanic name 'Ricard', meaning 'powerful ruler' or 'ruler of the people'. In Christianity, Ricarda is a variation of Richard, a popular name for both males and females in the Middle Ages. The name Ricarda carries the meaning “Powerful ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Ricarda usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name inspired by the strength and leadership of the Christian saints and rulers.
data.etymology: Ricarda belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Powerful ruler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ricarda total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: רִכָרְדָה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם רִכָרְדָה נלקח מהעברית, ומשמעותו היא 'אשה חזקה, חכמה, ומכובדת'. זהו שם נפוץ בעבר, ומופיע בספר שמות, פרשת בא. במסורת היהודית, השם רִכָרְדָה מיוחס לאחד מבני שמעון, ומשמעותו 'ראש, ראשוני'. בזמן ישראל הרומי, השם רִכָרְדָה נפוץ בקרב בני העם, ונחשב לשם טוב ואצילי. בנוסף, השם רִכָרְדָה נמצא בכמה פסלים וקברים, ובאחד מהם, 'רִכָרְדָה, בת יעקב', נזכר בתור 'בת יעקב'.

in_greek.name: Ριχάρδα
in_greek.long_meaning: Η ονομασία Ριχάρδα προέρχεται από την ελληνική γλώσσα, και σημαίνει 'αδύνατος, δυνατή, και ευσεβής γυνή'. Στον Ιουδαϊσμό, ονομαζόταν Ριχάρδα, από το Ριχάρ, που σημαίνει 'αδυνατός'. Αργότερα, η ονομασία Ριχάρδα έγινε γνωστή ως Ριχάρδ, από το Ριχάρ, που σημαίνει 'αδυνατός'. Στον Χριστιανισμό, η ονομασία Ριχάρδα, σημαίνει 'αδύνατος, δυνατή, και ευσεβής γυνή'.

in_latin.name: Ricarda
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Ricarda derivatur a Latina vocabulo, significans 'femina fortis, sapientis, et pia'. In antiquitate, nomen Ricarda erat commune in civitate, et significabatur 'fortis, sapientis, et pia'. In historia Ecclesiae, nomen Ricarda erat nomen sanctum, et significabatur 'mater virtutum, sapientis, et pia'.

in_english.name: Ricarda
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ricarda is of Latin origin, meaning 'strong, wise, and pious woman'. It is derived from the Latin words 'ric' meaning 'rich' or 'powerful' and 'arda' meaning 'noble' or 'exalted'. In the Christian tradition, the name Ricarda is associated with the virtue of strength, wisdom, and piety. It is also a variant of the name Ricard, which was popularized by the Normans. In the Middle Ages, the name Ricarda was given to girls born into noble families, reflecting the values of strength, wisdom, and piety that were highly prized in society.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ricarda holds a strong cultural impact, particularly in Europe during the Middle Ages. It was a name of power, emphasizing the inherent strength and leadership qualities of its bearer. Ricarda was a name for a woman who was capable of ruling her own household, community or even a kingdom. In literature and art, Ricarda often appears as a strong, independent and noble character, embodying the ideals of chivalry and honor.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Ricarda can be seen as a reminder of the power and authority that comes from God. It is a name that encourages its bearer to believe in their strength and capabilities, derived from their relationship with God. Ricarda can be a source of inspiration for women to be strong and confident in their faith, and to use their God-given abilities to lead and serve others. Many saints and revered women throughout history have been named Ricarda, highlighting the spiritual significance of this name.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Ricarda, derived from the Germanic name Richard, means "strong ruler" or "powerful leader." This name embodies the spiritual qualities of strength, courage, and determination in the face of challenges, inspiring its bearer to lead with wisdom and compassion.
